notes.text:
Presented by Analog Africa
Subtitle: "West African Shock Waves - Ghana & Togo 1972 - 1978"

The Double vinyl comes in a "De Lux" Gatefold. Inner sleeves are printed with pictures & liner notes of the artists and music history. Some early copies came with a Limited Edition big size poster.
Bonus vinyl tracks "Obiye Saa Wu", "Operation Bye-Bye" & "Okpe See"
Mastered at Soundmastering (London).
Track B3 mastered and restored at Osiris Studio (Atlanta).
